body: When you are desperate for an argument to end or an awkward dynamic to smooth over, paying an exorbitant emotional or financial tax for peace can suddenly look like a bargain. When the Moon squares Venus, the desire for comfort gets tangled with the pressure to keep everyone else happy, making immediate relief look infinitely more attractive than the hangover it leaves behind. The issue isn’t wanting ease; it’s trading away your boundaries, money, or time to buy it. A temporary truce isn't worth much if you have to abandon yourself to secure it.
